title: Small fictional RAG plumbing fixtures
notes: Seven inline-evidence questions and sixteen controlled claims. No corpus retrieval is performed by these evaluation questions. All facts are fictional. No independent human review, model quality, natural error prevalence or production readiness is claimed. Fixture markers intentionally exercise deterministic mock branches.

evidence.title: Fictional Orchard Returns
evidence.text:
Premium members can return unopened items within 30 days.
Return postage costs €5.
The loyalty promotion ends on 31 December 2026.
Only cardboard packaging is accepted for recycling.
Returns need an order number and proof of purchase.

evidence.title: Fictional Orchard Dispatch
evidence.text:
Standard orders are dispatched within two business days.
Priority orders placed before 11:00 are dispatched the same business day.
The dispatch team uses the North depot.
The North depot opens at 08:00 and closes at 17:00.

evidence.title: Fictional Acorn Guide A
evidence.text:
The Basic plan retains logs for 14 days.
This guide applies to Basic plans from 1 January 2026.

evidence.title: Fictional Acorn Guide B
evidence.text:
The Basic plan retains logs for 30 days.
This guide applies to Basic plans from 1 January 2026.
